description: Creates an online group card on SignUpSheet.page for one person: everyone opens one shared link and writes a message, and the organizer delivers the finished card later by email, on screen or printed. Use it for a farewell, birthday, retirement, thank-you, new baby, get well, sympathy, welcome, wedding, graduation, work anniversary or congratulations card from a team, class or family. It can also collect money for a gift (chip_in): signers pledge an amount and pay the organizer directly. Returns the share link (for signers, not for the recipient) and the private organizer link.

chip_in.description: Optional money collection on the same link. People pledge an amount and pay the organizer directly in the organizer's own payment app; SignUpSheet.page does not hold or transfer money. Include at least one way to pay, using only handles the user gave you. Venmo and Zelle work in US dollars only, Cash App in US dollars and pounds.

currency.description: Currency of the amounts. Default: US dollars when Venmo, Cash App or Zelle is given, otherwise the usual currency for the language.

other.description: Any other way to pay, as plain text (no links).

purpose.description: What the money is for, e.g. 'Gift for Ms. Lee'.

suggested_amount.description: Suggested amount per person, in whole units of the currency (default 10 US dollars or a similar round amount).

zelle.description: Zelle email or US phone the user gave.

language.description: Language of the pages and emails people will see. Use the language the user is writing in; 'en' if it is not in the list.

message_to_signers.description: Optional note shown to signers, e.g. 'Sign by Friday — we give it at lunch.' Plain text.

organizer_email.description: Optional. Only an email address the user gave in this conversation. If set, both links are emailed to it so the private organizer link is not lost. Never guess an address.

organizer_name.description: Name shown as the organizer, e.g. 'Dana'. Use the user's name if they gave it; otherwise omit.

recipient_name.description: Who the card is for, e.g. 'Sarah'.

show_messages.description: Let signers see each other's messages before the card is delivered.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the event, e.g. 'America/Chicago' or 'Europe/Madrid'. Needed when dates or times are given (reminders and calendar files use it).

title.description: Optional; defaults to e.g. 'Farewell card for Sarah' in the chosen language.

name: create_group_card

emailed_links_to.description: Masked address the links are being emailed to, or null.

flyer_url.description: Printable QR-code flyer for the sheet.

organizer_url.description: Private management link for the person who asked. Left out only when a repeated request returns a sheet whose organizer link went to the organizer email (see organizer_url_note).

share_url.description: Public link to send to participants.

title: Create group card
